newsitem.title: USA: Top US Republican wants real capital gains tax cut.
newsitem.headline: Top US Republican wants real capital gains tax cut.

text.p: U.S. Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott, R-Miss., said on Friday that Republicans planned to make "real" cuts in the capital gains tax as part of a package to balance the budget.
"We are going to cut the capital gains tax rate, and not in some symbolic way, in a real way," Lott told a meeting of the Republican National Committee.
Lott also promised that Republicans would match President Clinton's efforts to balance the budget, but said that Clinton must make the first move.
"If he is sincere about a balanced budget, if he shows courage, we will more than match him," Lott said.
He also said Republicans were "absolutely committed to a constitutional amendment for a balanced budget."
